target.reporting_basis: after transaction, financing, data and infrastructure costs; before personal taxes

research_questions.hypothesis: Volatility compression followed by a price breakout can precede a directional move large enough to exceed costs.
research_questions.candidate_rule: Build a channel from completed bars; trade a subsequent breakout only after the signal is received. Define the compression threshold and exit rules before evaluation.
research_questions.required_data: actual instrument intraday bars, bid/ask quotes, receipt timestamps, contract calendar if applicable
research_questions.falsification: No positive net expectancy in reserved chronological data, or profits vanish with observed execution delay and costs.

research_questions.hypothesis: A temporary price displacement after forced selling may revert when observable sell pressure subsides.
research_questions.candidate_rule: Define the pressure event from contemporaneous trade/quote information, and specify entry after pressure decay without using future lows.
research_questions.required_data: timestamped trades and order-book updates; authenticated liquidation feed if liquidation claims are used
research_questions.falsification: Edge requires knowing the eventual low or an unavailable liquidation timestamp, or disappears after adverse-selection costs.

research_questions.hypothesis: Some scheduled-event reactions continue after the first tradable response.
research_questions.candidate_rule: Freeze event types, the signal window and the first allowed entry timestamp. Keep entire events in one validation fold.
research_questions.required_data: release and receipt timestamps, revision-aware event data, actual bid/ask spreads around events
research_questions.falsification: Results depend on revised data, immediate pre-reaction fills, or a handful of events.

research_questions.hypothesis: A leading liquid market sometimes predicts a slower related market beyond executable latency and costs.
research_questions.candidate_rule: Freeze market pairs and lag definitions using training data; synchronize by receipt time and test delayed execution.
research_questions.required_data: synchronized quote streams with exchange and receive timestamps on both markets
research_questions.falsification: Apparent lead is a timestamp mismatch or the advantage disappears before an order can arrive.

research_questions.hypothesis: Short-horizon mean reversion can exist in a range regime defined using only prior observations.
research_questions.candidate_rule: Freeze the prior-data regime classifier, deviation threshold, stop and timed exit; include a trend-regime failure test.
research_questions.required_data: intraday prices and quotes, realistic marketable-order fills, gap and outage cases
research_questions.falsification: Mean reversion depends on retrospective regime labels, averaging down, or unrealistic stop fills.

validation_protocol: These five hypotheses are a design catalogue, not five completed or fully preregistered trading strategies.
Freeze economic mechanism, parameters, data hashes, code revision, costs, sample windows, primary metric and rejection rules before each experiment.
Separate chronological development/selection from untouched evaluation; purge or embargo overlapping labels and event groups.
Count all legacy, failed, interrupted and new variants when addressing selection bias; a new journal does not reset the trial count.
Record gross/net returns, turnover, actual elapsed time, drawdown, minimum tradable capital, exposure and concentration of profits.
Test baseline and stressed fees, spreads, delay, gaps, financing, rejected and partial fills; document data limitations explicitly.
For futures use actual contract multipliers, integer contracts, margin schedules and roll prices; never use ETF returns multiplied by leverage as executable evidence.
For passive orders evaluate profitability conditional on a fill and verify queue assumptions; touching a limit price does not prove a fill.
Use block/event resampling and a documented multiple-testing method when warranted; neither Monte Carlo nor a p-value proves future returns.
A short profitable sample must not be promoted as a demonstrated annual return. Include all cash costs and all inactivity.
Forward paper validation is a separate dataset with locked rules and order-event reconciliation; no live execution is implemented in this prototype.
